verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Status Pages are documented to give stakeholders real-time, visual updates on incident resolution without needing to join the incident channel or war room, positioning PagerDuty as the single source of truth for operational updates (pagerduty-docs-10, pagerduty-docs-17, pagerduty-docs-24, pagerduty-docs-29). However, the evidence never describes an explicit stakeholder 'subscribe' mechanism (e.g., email/SMS opt-in) or a structured update template/cadence for internal audiences, so the story is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit subscription workflow for stakeholders, structured update format/cadence details, and independent confirmation that non-responders actually use this instead of joining incident channels.
